_note: Draft. Sizes are approximate and every sha256 is unfilled: a checksum must be computed from the artifact that will actually be served, never copied from a listing. A null checksum must fail the download, not skip verification.

qwen3-1.7b-instruct-q4_k_m.note: Default. Chosen to leave room for the other three on a 6 GB device.

gemma-3-1b-it-q4_k_m.note: Tighter devices. WMT24++ 36.7 against the 4B's 48.4 — a real drop, not a small one.

translategemma-4b-q4_k_m.note: Best translation available at this scale. 8 GB devices only; does not fit beside whisper and the classifier at 6 GB.

whisper-tiny.note: Not a default: invents plausible kana on Japanese.

ipadic.note: Measured: 1 ms build, 14 MB resident, 0.12 ms/sentence. Not UniDic — see docs/decisions.md D5.

gliner2.5-multi-v1-int8.note: Default despite upstream recommending base: the English-only checkpoints are the wrong tool for an app about language pairs. Size unknown until exported and statically quantised.

gliner2.5-base-v1-int8.note: Upstream's recommended default, and the right one for English-only deployments.
